subject: Intro: Redwood Inference + Stellar Health — AWS co-sell kickoff and intake
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@stellarhealth.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@stellarhealth.io>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:10:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Intro: Redwood Inference & Stellar Health — AWS co-sell kickoff?

Hi Vanessa / Ben —

Thanks for taking this meeting request. Quick context: Stellar Health recently migrated several inference workloads to AWS and we're exploring a co-sell engagement to accelerate procurement and deployment for a pilot with three clinic customers. AWS recommended we connect with Redwood Inference to understand your co-sell process, any marketplace listing considerations, and what materials AWS needs to approve a co-sell designation.

High level goals for a kickoff call (60 min):
- Align stakeholders and success criteria (procurement, security, pilot scope)
- Review Redwood's AWS marketplace listing and co-sell prerequisites
- Map next 8-week mutual action plan (MAP) and identify blockers

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 5/26 10–11am
- Wed 5/27 1–2pm
- Thu 5/28 9–10am

Can you confirm which slot works and who from Redwood should join? I've attached a short two-pager on the pilot requirements.

Thanks —
Alyssa Grant
Head of Partnerships | Stellar Health
alyssa.grant@stellarhealth.io
Attachment: Stellar-pilot-needs.docx (summary)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@stellarhealth.io>, Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@stellarhealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood Inference & Stellar Health — AWS co-sell kickoff?

Hi Alyssa — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the note. We're excited to explore a co-sell with Stellar. I can join the kickoff and want to loop in Ben (go-to-market lead) and Kim (partner/marketplace lead) to cover the AWS intake and security gate checklist.

From Redwood's side, typical intake items AWS asks for early are:
- Marketplace listing readiness (pricing SKU, listing owner)
- Primary technical contact and short architecture diagram
- SOC 2 statement + any customer-facing data flow docs
- Suggested commercial construct for pilot (trial credits, POC pricing)

Proposed: let's lock Wed 5/27 1–2pm PDT. If that works I'll send a calendar invite and a short map of the meeting agenda. For the MAP, if you can share procurement timelines and key legal contacts that will help us populate the timeline.

Ben / Kim — can you confirm who will own the technical walkthrough and who will drive the MAP doc? I have a Redwood AWS co-sell checklist I'll attach after this thread.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior GTM Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Stellar Health co-sell — roles & deliverables

Vanessa / Kim —

Quick internal plan before we send the invite:
- Ben: lead commercial & MAP timeline (I'll draft the initial MAP).
- Kim: lead marketplace intake (listing, AWS contacts) + security intake (SOC 2 artifacts).
- Vanessa: executive sponsor for kickoff and escalation path.

Deliverables to attach before kickoff:
1) MAP-timeline.xlsx (initial 8-week plan)
2) SOW-draft-v1.pdf (POC commercial outline)
3) Redwood-AWS-cosell-checklist.pdf (what AWS requires for co-sell)

I'll attach 1–2 now and iterate. Also pinging AWS field rep for co-sell intake after the kickoff.

—Ben
Attachment: MAP-timeline.xlsx; SOW-draft-v1.pdf
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@stellarhealth.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood Inference & Stellar Health — AWS co-sell kickoff?

Thanks — Wed 5/27 1–2pm PDT works for us. We'll have:
- Alyssa Grant (me) — partnerships / program owner
- Tom Reynolds — CIO (technical/architecture)
- Morgan Lee — procurement (I'll add to the invite once I confirm availability)

I attached a short procurement snapshot and the contact for our legal reviewer (legal@stellarhealth.io). Looking forward to the MAP and the checklist you mentioned.

On Wed we'd like to cover:
- One-slide architecture review (Tom)
- AWS co-sell requirements + timing (Redwood/AWS)
- Pilot commercial proposal (Ben)
- Next steps / action owners

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Alyssa
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood Inference & Stellar Health — AWS co-sell kickoff?

All set — invite sent for Wed 2026-05-27 13:00–14:00 PDT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdefg12345

I've attached the initial MAP (MAP-timeline.xlsx) and the SOW draft. Kim also attached the Redwood-AWS-cosell-checklist for the safety/security gates. Please review the attachments before the call; we'll spend the first 10 minutes on scope and we'll assign owners to the MAP live.

Pre-call ask for Stellar: please upload any SOC 2 summary or security one-pager to the shared Drive link so Kim can pre-read: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAP
